chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, raised it to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
He said: 'The one who wears a ring with the turquoise, would not impoverish his palm'.

key_terms.الْفَيْرُوزَجِ: Turquoise, a semi-precious stone often used in rings
key_terms.تَخَتَّمَ: To wear a ring (specifically on the finger)
key_terms.كَفُّهُ: His hand/palm, used here metonymically for his means or sustenance

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of wearing a turquoise ring according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the wearing of a turquoise ring to divine provision (rizq), reflecting the Shia tradition of seeking blessings through specific adornments. It underscores the belief that such acts, when done with intention, serve as a means (sabab) for alleviating financial hardship and attracting God's favor.
